instruction: Select the earliest upcoming meeting from the calendar now. After refreshing, open notes for that exact meeting.
Reload the calendar first; select the earliest upcoming meeting only from the updated view and open notes for that meeting.
Using the pre-refresh view, choose the earliest upcoming meeting. Reload the calendar; then open notes for the one chosen earlier.
Do not choose a target until after the calendar synchronizes. Then determine the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for that meeting.
Record the identity of the earliest upcoming meeting before synchronization. Once the calendar sync completes, open notes for that recorded meeting.
Once the calendar has refreshed, determine the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for the resulting meeting.
Mark the earliest upcoming meeting in the current calendar list. Update the view and open notes for that marked meeting.
Discard the pre-refresh ranking. Refresh the calendar, identify the earliest upcoming meeting anew, and open notes for that meeting.
Resolve the earliest upcoming meeting at this point. Following a reload of the calendar, open notes for the previously resolved meeting.
Update the calendar data, then newly identify the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for that meeting.
Look over the current calendar and note the earliest upcoming meeting. Refresh the view, then open notes for it.
Synchronize the calendar; then, from what is displayed afterward, locate the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for it.
Which meeting is the earliest upcoming meeting right now? Keep it in mind, reload the calendar, and open notes for it.
Wait for the calendar reload to finish before working out the earliest upcoming meeting, then open notes for it.
Pick the earliest upcoming meeting from the current list; after syncing the calendar, open notes for it.
Use only the post-update calendar list to locate the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for it.
Find the earliest upcoming meeting in the calendar as it stands. Update the view, then open notes for it.
Let the calendar refresh. Based on the resulting list, work out the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for it.
Inspect the current calendar and settle on the earliest upcoming meeting. Reload the view, then open notes for it.
The refresh must happen before the target is settled. In the updated calendar, locate the earliest upcoming meeting and open notes for it.
